data.summary:
Transformation & Program Delivery Leader with 17+ years of experience driving enterprise transformation initiatives across global banking and GCC environments. Experienced in leading end-to-end transformation programs spanning operating model redesign, process re-engineering, automation adoption, and performance improvement.
Delivered USD 1.86M in cost optimization, ~20% performance uplift, and up to 55% efficiency gains through structured transformation programs, disciplined program governance, and data-driven execution.
Driving responsible adoption of AI-enabled capabilities by establishing governance frameworks, execution models, and guardrails that support scalable and compliant integration of AI into enterprise workflows.
Trusted partner to senior stakeholders, translating strategic priorities into executable transformation roadmaps and leading cross-functional teams to deliver measurable and sustainable business outcomes.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Transformation & Program Delivery Leader with 17+ years of experience driving enterprise transformation initiatives across global banking and GCC environments. Experienced in leading end-to-end transformation programs spanning operating model redesign, process re-engineering, automation adoption, and performance improvement.
Delivered USD 1.86M in cost optimization, ~20% performance uplift, and up to 55% efficiency gains through structured transformation programs, disciplined program governance, and data-driven execution.
Driving responsible adoption of AI-enabled capabilities by establishing governance frameworks, execution models, and guardrails that support scalable and compliant integration of AI into enterprise workflows.
Trusted partner to senior stakeholders, translating strategic priorities into executable transformation roadmaps and leading cross-functional teams to deliver measurable and sustainable business outcomes.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
VP – Lead Control Management Officer - Wells Fargo - Oct 2022 to Present • Executed enterprise control evaluation activities, partnering with business, risk, and compliance stakeholders to
assess control testing effectiveness and strengthen risk monitoring across critical banking processes.

Automated QA workbook validation using VBA, eliminating manual errors and field mismatches across multi- sheet testing workbooks and improving accuracy and efficiency of QA reviews.
Developed VBA-based decision support tools, embedding business logic to enable faster and more consistent

evaluation of control testing outcomes. Implemented centralized SharePoint-based QA tracking, enabling real-time visibility into QA sample completion, observations, and testing progress.
Contributing to AI governance and Prompt Engineering for Control Management defining usage standards, control frameworks, and operating guardrails to enable safe and effective adoption of AI-driven capabilities.
AVP – HSBC - Mar 2019 to Oct 2022 •
Spearheaded large-scale service transformation initiatives across global teams (1,000+ FTEs), improving delivery resilience, performance consistency, and customer outcomes. Transformed customer experience transformation through process excellence and service improvement initiatives.

Delivered cost transformation initiatives, improving operational efficiency while sustaining service performance. Implemented process automation and digitization initiatives, improving cycle times and efficiency across • banking workflows.
Developed enterprise performance dashboards and transformation metrics to support data-driven decision

making. Institutionalized transformation governance frameworks enabling structured execution of cross-functional change programs.

•

Streamlined fraud monitoring, reconciliation, and dispute processes, improving accuracy and turnaround time
